source: Historical topic-local HP sequence retained for a deterministic mechanics benchmark; no external protein dataset is used.
coordinate_unit: one lattice step; dimensionless model coordinate
energy_unit: HP model unit; not SI energy or protein free energy
contact_rule: Count H-H contacts only when Manhattan distance is one and residue indices differ by more than one.
symmetry_breaking: Fix residue 0 at [0, 0] and residue 1 at [1, 0] for exhaustive enumeration and stochastic runs.
preprocessing: None; the sequence is consumed exactly as declared.
